+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING — COMPOSITION rung 11: SUM TYPES + constructor-pattern dispatch
+# ===========================================================================
+# Rung 10 made the whole front-end verified ports but the composed build only
+# exercised selfhost_decl's arithmetic/list slice. selfhost_decl ALREADY parses
+# `type Name := A | B(T, …)` declarations and constructor patterns/values — that
+# capability is equivalence-locked but was unused. This rung widens build's
+# SURFACE to use it: sum-type declarations and constructor dispatch, e.g.
+#
+#   type Color := Red | Green | Blue
+#   def code(Red) := 0
+#   def code(Green) := 1
+#   def code(Blue) := 2
+#
+# No verified port changes — the front-end (SelfhostLexerV2 + SelfhostDecl) and
+# back-end (SelfhostBeam) are the same locked ports as rung 10. Only the driver
+# glue grows: the `type` declaration is ERASED (variants are atoms / tagged tuples
+# on the BEAM — no codegen), and the Form inflater learns FCtorN / FCtor:
+#   nullary ctor pattern/value -> {:atom, 0, snake_atom}     (Red -> :red)
+#   applied ctor              -> {:tuple, 0, [{:atom,0,tag} | args]}  (Pair(a,b))
+# via a `to_snake` matching Rian.PatternLower.to_snake (SNum -> :s_num, SP -> :sp).
+#
+# Pipeline (unchanged from rung 10 except the wider inflater):
+#   SelfhostLexerV2.tokenize → SelfhostDecl.parse_program → normalize (drops DType)
+#     → surface→Core lowering → SelfhostBeam.compile_forms → inflate → load
+#
+# All three ports load under :"Elixir.Selfhost*" atoms (Pascal calls, ADR-0041);
+# sibling-port calls are composition, not host crutches. Only host FFI:
+# :compile.forms / :code.load_binary. selfhost_decl still lacks `if`/strings, so
+# widening it off :partial remains the path to a real selfhost_*.rian slice.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostComposeRealSum do
+  # ── selfhost_beam's INPUT IR (the shared contract — structurally identical) ──
+  type Core := CNum(String)
+             | CId(String)
+             | CAtom(String)
+             | CUnary(String, Core)
+             | CBin(String, Core, Core)
+             | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
+             | CTuple(Vec(Core))
+             | CList(Vec(Core), Tail)
+             | CIf(Core, Block, Block)
+             | CCase(Core, Vec(Arm))
+
+  type Tail := TClose | TTail(Core)
+  type Block := Block(Vec(Stmt))
+  type Stmt := SBind(String, Core) | STypedBind(String, String, Core) | SExpr(Core)
+  type Arm := Arm(Pat, Guard, Block)
+
+  type Pat := PWild
+            | PVar(String)
+            | PInt(Int53)
+            | PAtom(String)
+            | PCtor(String, Vec(Pat))
+            | PTuple(Vec(Pat))
+            | PList(Vec(Pat), PTail)
+
+  type PTail := PtlClose | PtlTail(Pat)
+  type Guard := GNone | GSome(Core)
+  type Clause := Clause(Vec(Pat), Guard, Block)
+  type Func := Func(String, Int53, Vec(Clause))
+
+  # ── selfhost_beam's OUTPUT (the string-carrying Form sum we inflate) ──
+  type Form := FInt(Int53)
+             | FVar(String)
+             | FAtom(String)
+             | FCtorN(String)
+             | FCtor(String, Vec(Form))
+             | FOp1(String, Form)
+             | FOp2(String, Form, Form)
+             | FCall(String, Vec(Form))
+             | FTuple(Vec(Form))
+             | FNil
+             | FCons(Form, Form)
+             | FIf(Form, Vec(Form), Vec(Form))
+             | FCase(Form, Vec(FClause))
+             | FMatch(String, Form)
+
+  type GForm := GfNone | GfSome(Form)
+  type FClause := FClause(Vec(Form), GForm, Vec(Form))
+  type FFunc := FFunc(String, Int53, Vec(FClause))
+
+  # ── driver-local types ──
+  type NClause := NC(String, Vec(Pat), Core)
+  type Grp := Grp(String, Int53, Vec(NClause))
+
+  # ── the BEAM toolchain boundary: two @external(:ex) host calls (counted FFI) ──
+  @external(:ex, ":compile.forms(forms, [:return_errors])")
+  def compile_forms_host(forms Vec(Tuple)) Tuple
+
+  @external(:ex, ":code.load_binary(name, chars, bin)")
+  def load_binary(name Symbol, chars Vec(Int53), bin String) Tuple
+
+  # ── the driver: source -> a loaded, runnable module ──
+  pub def build(src String, modname Symbol) Symbol
+  pub def build(src, modname)
+    case compile_forms_host(compile_module(src, modname)) do
+      {:ok, m, bin} -> loaded(load_binary(m, Prim.str_chars("nofile"), bin))
+    end
+  end
+
+  def loaded(Tuple) Symbol
+  def loaded({:module, m}) := m
+
+  # ── source -> a full :compile.forms input, via the REAL lexer + parser + backend ──
+  # the front-end is entirely verified ports: SelfhostLexerV2.tokenize feeds
+  # SelfhostDecl.parse_program directly (same token tags, no projection).
+  pub def compile_module(src String, modname Symbol) Vec(Tuple)
+  pub def compile_module(src, modname) := assemble(modname, funcs(group(normalize(SelfhostDecl.parse_program(SelfhostLexerV2.tokenize(src))))))
+
+  def assemble(modname Symbol, fs Vec(Func)) Vec(Tuple) := [{:attribute, 0, :module, modname}, {:attribute, 0, :export, exports(fs)} | inflate_funcs(SelfhostBeam.compile_forms(fs))]
+
+  def exports(Vec(Func)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def exports([]) := []
+  def exports([Func(name, arity, _) | rest]) := [{Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity} | exports(rest)]
+
+  # ── normalize: selfhost_decl's Decl IR -> a flat list of (name, pats, body) ──
+  def normalize(ds) Vec(NClause)
+  def normalize([]) := []
+  def normalize([{:d_clause, name, pats, expr} | rest]) := [NC(name, lower_pats(pats), lower_surface(expr)) | normalize(rest)]
+  def normalize([_ | rest]) := normalize(rest)
+
+  # ── the surface→Core lowering: selfhost_decl Pat/Expr -> selfhost_beam Pat/Core ──
+  def lower_pats(ps) Vec(Pat)
+  def lower_pats([]) := []
+  def lower_pats([p | rest]) := [lower_pat(p) | lower_pats(rest)]
+
+  def lower_pat(p) Pat
+  def lower_pat(:wild) := PWild
+  def lower_pat(:nil_p) := PList([], PtlClose)
+  def lower_pat({:var, n}) := PVar(n)
+  def lower_pat({:lit, k}) := PInt(k)
+  def lower_pat({:ctor, c, ps}) := PCtor(c, lower_pats(ps))
+  def lower_pat({:cons_p, h, t}) := cons_pat([lower_pat(h)], t)
+
+  # flatten a cons-pattern chain `[a, b | tl]` into PList([a, b], tail).
+  def cons_pat(acc Vec(Pat), t) Pat
+  def cons_pat(acc, :nil_p) := PList(rev_pats(acc, []), PtlClose)
+  def cons_pat(acc, {:cons_p, h, t}) := cons_pat([lower_pat(h) | acc], t)
+  def cons_pat(acc, other) := PList(rev_pats(acc, []), PtlTail(lower_pat(other)))
+
+  def rev_pats(Vec(Pat), Vec(Pat)) Vec(Pat)
+  def rev_pats([], out) := out
+  def rev_pats([p | rest], out) := rev_pats(rest, [p | out])
+
+  def lower_surface(e) Core
+  def lower_surface({:num, s}) := CNum(s)
+  def lower_surface({:id, x}) := CId(x)
+  def lower_surface({:bin, op, l, r}) := CBin(op, lower_surface(l), lower_surface(r))
+  def lower_surface({:unary, op, x}) := CUnary(op, lower_surface(x))
+  def lower_surface({:call, callee, args}) := CCall(callee_name(callee), lower_all(args))
+
+  def callee_name(c) String
+  def callee_name({:id, f}) := f
+
+  def lower_all(es) Vec(Core)
+  def lower_all([]) := []
+  def lower_all([e | rest]) := [lower_surface(e) | lower_all(rest)]
+
+  # ── group consecutive same-name clauses, wrap each as a beam Func ──
+  def group(Vec(NClause)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group([]) := []
+  def group([NC(name, pats, body) | rest]) := group_run(name, plen(pats), [NC(name, pats, body)], rest)
+
+  def group_run(name String, arity Int53, acc Vec(NClause), Vec(NClause)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, []) := [Grp(name, arity, rev_ncs(acc, []))]
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, [NC(n2, p2, b2) | rest])
+    if name == n2 do
+      group_run(name, arity, [NC(n2, p2, b2) | acc], rest)
+    else
+      [Grp(name, arity, rev_ncs(acc, [])) | group([NC(n2, p2, b2) | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_ncs(Vec(NClause), Vec(NClause)) Vec(NClause)
+  def rev_ncs([], out) := out
+  def rev_ncs([c | rest], out) := rev_ncs(rest, [c | out])
+
+  def funcs(Vec(Grp)) Vec(Func)
+  def funcs([]) := []
+  def funcs([Grp(name, arity, ncs) | rest]) := [Func(name, arity, clauses_of(ncs)) | funcs(rest)]
+
+  def clauses_of(Vec(NClause)) Vec(Clause)
+  def clauses_of([]) := []
+  def clauses_of([NC(_, pats, body) | rest]) := [Clause(pats, GNone, Block([SExpr(body)])) | clauses_of(rest)]
+
+  def plen(Vec(Pat)) Int53
+  def plen([]) := 0
+  def plen([_ | rest]) := 1 + plen(rest)
+
+  # ── inflate selfhost_beam's Form sum -> real abstract-form tuples ──
+  def inflate_funcs(Vec(FFunc)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def inflate_funcs([]) := []
+  def inflate_funcs([f | rest]) := [inflate_func(f) | inflate_funcs(rest)]
+
+  def inflate_func(FFunc) Tuple
+  def inflate_func(FFunc(name, arity, clauses)) := {:function, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity, inflate_clauses(clauses)}
+
+  def inflate_clauses(Vec(FClause)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def inflate_clauses([]) := []
+  def inflate_clauses([c | rest]) := [inflate_clause(c) | inflate_clauses(rest)]
+
+  def inflate_clause(FClause) Tuple
+  def inflate_clause(FClause(pats, guard, body)) := {:clause, 0, inflate_all(pats), guard_seq(guard), inflate_all(body)}
+
+  def guard_seq(GForm) Vec(Vec(Tuple))
+  def guard_seq(GfNone) := []
+  def guard_seq(GfSome(g)) := [[inflate(g)]]
+
+  def inflate_all(Vec(Form)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def inflate_all([]) := []
+  def inflate_all([f | rest]) := [inflate(f) | inflate_all(rest)]
+
+  def inflate(Form) Tuple
+  def inflate(FInt(v)) := {:integer, 0, v}
+  def inflate(FVar(n)) := {:var, 0, var_atom(n)}
+  def inflate(FAtom(a)) := {:atom, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(a)}
+  def inflate(FNil) := {:nil, 0}
+  def inflate(FCons(h, t)) := {:cons, 0, inflate(h), inflate(t)}
+  def inflate(FOp1(op, x)) := {:op, 0, op_atom(op), inflate(x)}
+  def inflate(FOp2(op, l, r)) := {:op, 0, op_atom(op), inflate(l), inflate(r)}
+  def inflate(FCall(f, args)) := {:call, 0, {:atom, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(f)}, inflate_all(args)}
+  # a nullary constructor (pattern or value) is its snake_case atom; an applied
+  # constructor is a tagged tuple {tag, arg, …} — the BEAM rep of a sum value.
+  def inflate(FCtorN(c)) := {:atom, 0, to_snake(c)}
+  def inflate(FCtor(c, args)) := {:tuple, 0, [{:atom, 0, to_snake(c)} | inflate_all(args)]}
+
+  def var_atom(n String) Symbol := Prim.str_to_atom(cap(n))
+
+  # constructor name -> snake_case atom, matching Rian.PatternLower.to_snake:
+  # insert `_` before an uppercase that follows a lower/digit, OR before the last
+  # uppercase of a cap-run when a lowercase follows (SNum -> s_num, SP -> sp,
+  # PPr -> p_pr); then downcase. So a variant value/pattern gets its BEAM tag.
+  def to_snake(s String) Symbol := Prim.str_to_atom(Prim.str_from_chars(snake_walk(0, Prim.str_chars(s))))
+
+  def snake_walk(prev Int53, Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53)
+  def snake_walk(prev, []) := []
+  def snake_walk(prev, [c | rest])
+    if needs_us(prev, c, rest) do
+      [95, low(c) | snake_walk(c, rest)]
+    else
+      [low(c) | snake_walk(c, rest)]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def needs_us(prev Int53, c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Bool
+  def needs_us(prev, c, rest)
+    if is_upper(c) do
+      (is_lower(prev) or is_digit(prev)) or (is_upper(prev) and next_lower(rest))
+    else
+      false
+    end
+  end
+
+  def next_lower(Vec(Int53)) Bool
+  def next_lower([]) := false
+  def next_lower([h | _]) := is_lower(h)
+
+  def is_upper(c Int53) Bool := c >= 65 and c <= 90
+  def is_lower(c Int53) Bool := c >= 97 and c <= 122
+  def is_digit(c Int53) Bool := c >= 48 and c <= 57
+  def low(c Int53) Int53 := up_to_low(c)
+
+  def up_to_low(c Int53) Int53
+    if is_upper(c) do
+      c + 32
+    else
+      c
+    end
+  end
+
+  def op_atom(String) Symbol
+  def op_atom("+") := :"+"
+  def op_atom("-") := :"-"
+  def op_atom("*") := :"*"
+
+  def cap(s String) String
+    case Prim.str_chars(s) do
+      [c | rest] -> Prim.str_from_chars([up(c) | rest])
+      [] -> s
+    end
+  end
+
+  def up(c Int53) Int53
+    if c >= 97 and c <= 122 do
+      c - 32
+    else
+      c
+    end
+  end
+end

+defmodule Rian.ComposeRealSumFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — loads verified ports (by their natural atoms) + the driver, and
+  # the driver loads compiled modules at runtime.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.Beam
+
+  # COMPOSITION fixpoint rung 11 (ADR-0063 Step 3): widens the composed build's
+  # SURFACE to sum types + constructor-pattern dispatch, using selfhost_decl's
+  # already-locked `type`/ctor capability (no verified-port changes). The driver
+  # glue grows only by: erasing `type` declarations and inflating FCtorN/FCtor
+  # (nullary ctor -> snake atom; applied ctor -> tagged tuple), via a `to_snake`
+  # matching Rian.PatternLower.to_snake.
+  #
+  #   SelfhostLexerV2.tokenize → SelfhostDecl.parse_program → normalize (drops DType)
+  #     → surface→Core lowering → SelfhostBeam.compile_forms → inflate → load
+  #
+  # The test loads all three verified ports under their :"Elixir.Selfhost*" atoms,
+  # then calls only `build/2` and runs the result, identical to `Rian.Beam` — now
+  # over sum-type programs (Color/Shape/Box) with constructor dispatch.
+
+  setup_all do
+    {:ok, _} =
+      Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_lexer_v2.rian"), :"Elixir.SelfhostLexerV2")
+
+    {:ok, _} = Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_decl.rian"), :"Elixir.SelfhostDecl")
+    {:ok, _} = Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_beam.rian"), :"Elixir.SelfhostBeam")
+
+    {:ok, drv} =
+      Beam.load(
+        File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_compose_real_sum.rian"),
+        :rian_compose_real_sum
+      )
+
+    {:ok, drv: drv}
+  end
+
+  defp ref_module(src) do
+    {:ok, m} = Beam.load(src, :"cmp_rs_ref_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
+    m
+  end
+
+  # {pipeline source (untyped), reference source (typed sigs), [{fn, args}] to run}.
+  @corpus [
+    # nullary variants → snake atoms; constructor-pattern dispatch
+    {
+      "type Color := Red | Green | Blue\ndef code(Red) := 0\ndef code(Green) := 1\ndef code(Blue) := 2",
+      "type Color := Red | Green | Blue\ndef code(c Color) Int53\ndef code(Red) := 0\ndef code(Green) := 1\ndef code(Blue) := 2",
+      [{:code, [:red]}, {:code, [:green]}, {:code, [:blue]}]
+    },
+    # applied variants → tagged tuples; payload destructuring in patterns
+    {
+      "type Shape := Circle(Int53) | Rect(Int53, Int53)\ndef area(Circle(r)) := r * r\ndef area(Rect(w, h)) := w * h",
+      "type Shape := Circle(Int53) | Rect(Int53, Int53)\ndef area(s Shape) Int53\ndef area(Circle(r)) := r * r\ndef area(Rect(w, h)) := w * h",
+      [{:area, [{:circle, 5}]}, {:area, [{:rect, 3, 4}]}, {:area, [{:circle, 10}]}]
+    },
+    # constructor VALUE in a body builds a tagged tuple
+    {
+      "type Box := B(Int53)\ndef wrap(n) := B(n)\ndef unwrap(B(n)) := n",
+      "type Box := B(Int53)\ndef wrap(n Int53) Box := B(n)\ndef unwrap(b Box) Int53\ndef unwrap(B(n)) := n",
+      [{:wrap, [7]}, {:wrap, [42]}, {:unwrap, [{:b, 9}]}]
+    }
+  ]
+
+  describe "sum-type fixpoint — constructor dispatch runs identically to Elixir" do
+    test "build/2 compiles sum types + ctor patterns equal to Rian.Beam's", %{drv: drv} do
+      for {rian_src, ref_src, calls} <- @corpus do
+        modname = :"cmp_rs_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
+        loaded = drv.build(rian_src, modname)
+        assert loaded == modname
+
+        ref = ref_module(ref_src)
+
+        for {fname, args} <- calls do
+          assert apply(loaded, fname, args) == apply(ref, fname, args),
+                 "driver(sum) `#{fname}` diverged from Elixir toolchain on #{inspect(args)}"
+        end
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "teeth — `type` is erased; ctors become atoms / tagged tuples" do
+    test "nullary ctor patterns lower to snake atoms; type decl is dropped", %{drv: drv} do
+      # the `type` line produces no form; the function pattern is the variant atom.
+      [_m, {:attribute, 0, :export, exports} | funcs] =
+        drv.compile_module(
+          "type Color := Red | Green\ndef code(Red) := 0\ndef code(Green) := 1",
+          :rs_color
+        )
+
+      assert exports == [{:code, 1}]
+      assert [{:function, 0, :code, 1, [c0, c1]}] = funcs
+      assert {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, :red}], [], [{:integer, 0, 0}]} = c0
+      assert {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, :green}], [], [{:integer, 0, 1}]} = c1
+    end
+
+    test "to_snake matches Rian's convention (consecutive caps collapse)", %{drv: drv} do
+      # SNum -> :s_num, SP -> :sp — multi-cap variant tags lower like Rian.PatternLower.
+      [_m, _e, {:function, 0, :tag, 1, [a, b]}] =
+        drv.compile_module(
+          "type T := SNum(Int53) | SP\ndef tag(SNum(_)) := 1\ndef tag(SP) := 2",
+          :rs_snake
+        )
+
+      assert {:clause, 0, [{:tuple, 0, [{:atom, 0, :s_num} | _]}], [], _} = a
+      assert {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, :sp}], [], _} = b
+    end
+
+    test "an applied constructor value builds a tagged tuple", %{drv: drv} do
+      m = drv.build("type Box := B(Int53)\ndef wrap(n) := B(n)", :rs_wrap)
+      assert apply(m, :wrap, [99]) == {:b, 99}
+    end
+  end
+end
